claims.text: THE ONLY JICARILLA APACHE NATION OFFICIAL WHOSE WORDS WERE OPENED. Legislative Council President Ty Vicenti, quoted in a May 2016 newspaper feature, issues a tourism welcome inviting visitors to 'talk to the many tribal members who have first hand contact with UFO sightings and stories'. He is NOT quoted asserting or denying the existence of a base, and no position of the Nation was established.
